questions.question: align-content controls:

options.text: Distribution of FLEX LINES (rows) when there's extra cross-axis space and wrapping

questions.explanation: align-content only matters with flex-wrap and multiple lines; it spaces the lines themselves along the cross axis.

questions.question: align-self overrides for a single item the container's:

options.text: align-items (cross-axis alignment of that one item)

questions.explanation: align-self lets one item opt out of the container's align-items, e.g. push one card to flex-end.

questions.question: order: -1 on a flex item:

options.text: Moves it earlier in the visual order (before items with default order 0)

questions.explanation: order changes visual placement without HTML reordering; negative values sort before 0. Use sparingly for a11y (source order stays).

questions.question: A flex item's automatic minimum size can cause overflow because:

options.text: flex items have min-width:auto by default, refusing to shrink below content size

questions.explanation: min-width:auto means an item won't shrink below its content; set min-width:0 to allow shrinking (fixes common flex overflow bugs).

questions.question: flex: 0 1 auto (the initial value) means:

options.text: Don't grow, allow shrink, basis = content/auto size

questions.explanation: Default flex: 0 1 auto → won't grow to fill, can shrink, starts at auto size. flex:1 (1 1 0%) is the equal-share variant.

questions.question: To create a sticky footer with flexbox you set the container:

options.text: min-height:100vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; and main { flex:1 }

questions.explanation: A column flex container at full viewport height, with the main region growing (flex:1), pushes the footer down.

questions.question: flex-direction: column-reverse reverses:

options.text: The main axis (items flow bottom-to-top); cross-axis alignment unaffected

questions.explanation: *-reverse flips the main axis direction only; justify-content then applies reversed. align-items stays the same axis.

questions.question: A common pitfall: nesting many flex containers can:

options.text: Complicate layout debugging and stretch performance if overused

questions.explanation: Deep flex nesting is hard to reason about; prefer Grid for 2D and reserve flex for 1D alignment. Use containment for perf.
